svg.aria-label: Three first-position finger patterns: G and D major with the half-step between fingers 2 and 3, C major on the D string with the half-step between 1 and 2, and F major on the A string with a low first finger for B flat
svg.text: Grade 2 finger patterns: where the half-step goes
Same fingers, three hand shapes. Fingers side by side = a half-step; a one-slot gap = a whole step.
On the fingerboard (nut on the left)
dashed circle = where that finger sat in the Grade 1 shape
each tick on the board = one half-step (semitone)
Finger 0 = open string. From Chapter 1 of this post.
